title: Tuna Kimchi Fried Rice
summary: An easy Korean rice dish stir-fried with well-fermented kimchi, tuna, and egg, with optional roasted seaweed flakes on top.

steps.description: Cut the kimchi into 1 to 2 cm pieces, finely chop the onion, and thinly slice the green onion. Drain the tuna well and lightly beat the 2 eggs.
Heat 1/2 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the eggs and stir in large curds until softly set, then transfer them to a plate.

Add the remaining 1/2 tbsp cooking oil to the same pan and stir-fry the green onion and onion for about 1 minute. Add the kimchi and 1 tsp sugar, then cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the kimchi softens.

Add 400 g cooked rice and 2 tbsp kimchi juice, breaking up the rice as you mix. Pour 1 tbsp soy sauce around the edge of the pan and stir-fry over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes to cook off excess moisture.
Add the drained tuna and cooked egg. Stir-fry gently for about 1 minute so the tuna stays in visible pieces.
Turn off the heat and mix in 1 tsp sesame oil. Serve in bowls and, if desired, finish with 2 tbsp roasted seaweed flakes.
